verdict.rationale: Martin surfaces AI-driven suggestions via daily/weekly briefings, proactive email drafts, and automatic email triage that act on the user's data, and community feedback confirms it can handle complex requests well. However, these are action-oriented (drafting/sending/labeling) rather than explicit data insights or analytics summaries, and there's no evidence of dedicated insight dashboards or trend analysis. Missing for 10: explicit data-insight/analytics presentation, independent validation of insight quality beyond anecdotal praise.
